evals.name: Canonical Link Tag & URL Normalization
evals.prompt: Implement canonical link tag strategy for apex domain vs subdomain routing, preventing duplicate content penalties in Google Search Console.
evals.expected_output: Injects link rel=canonical with absolute canonical URL, strips tracking query parameters, and ensures self-referencing subdomains.
assertions: Renders explicit <link rel='canonical' href='...'> in document head
Enforces single apex domain vs www hostname consistency
Configures self-referencing canonical URL on subdomains
Strips dynamic UTM and tracking query parameters from canonical URL

evals.name: XML Sitemap & Robots.txt Directives
evals.prompt: Generate a compliant sitemap.xml with prioritized URLs and configure robots.txt referencing the public sitemap endpoint.
evals.expected_output: Creates valid XML sitemap with lastmod, changefreq, and priority tags, and exposes Sitemap directive in robots.txt.
assertions: Defines valid XML sitemap structure conforming to sitemaps.org schema
Assigns priority tiers (1.0 for home, 0.8 for tools, 0.3 for legal)
Configures robots.txt referencing absolute sitemap URL
Disallows crawler indexing of private administrative and API routes

evals.name: JSON-LD WebApplication Schema Rich Snippet
evals.prompt: Embed structured Schema.org JSON-LD structured data into the HTML head for a WebApplication entity with licensing and author metadata.
evals.expected_output: Injects application/ld+json script tag with valid Schema.org WebApplication or SoftwareApplication structure.
assertions: Embeds script type='application/ld+json' in document head
Declares Schema.org context and WebApplication or SoftwareApplication type
Provides application name, url, description, and operatingSystem properties
Includes author or creator entity metadata
